subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this stale onboarding branch be closed as superseded by current main, or should maintainers sponsor a narrow rebase for any remaining UX pieces?
rationale: The branch overlaps multiple merged maintainer PRs and still carries security/auth merge blockers, so automation should not choose whether to discard or salvage it under the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR and point contributors to the merged current-main onboarding and local Gateway setup work for the central behavior.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase only unique UX changes onto current main, fix the P1 blockers, and add real macOS setup proof.

options.title: Keep broad branch open
options.body: Maintain the current broad branch as a product-development lane, accepting that it needs manual ownership and security review before merge.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR and point contributors to the merged current-main onboarding and local Gateway setup work for the central behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged mainline macOS onboarding and Gateway setup changes that now define the likely product direction.
